# site-chrome

The SITE CHROME: the just-the-docs theme configuration (`_config.yml`'s theme keys, the `Gemfile`), the generic includes every page pulls in (`head_custom`, `footer_custom`, `nav_footer_custom`, `mermaid_config`) and the stylesheets and scripts they load, in their Jekyll-relative places. Concern group `ui`. It is the BASE layer of the composed docs tree: declared BEFORE `docs`, so `compose-docs` lays it down first and `docs/` overlays it (later wins; `_config.yml` merged, parse-equal to the file it was cut from, ruling D1). Empty `_includes/generated/*` stand-ins let a site with no harness pages build. A downstream that wants the harness's look without its 3,456 pages mounts `site-chrome` and omits `docs`. Owner, 2026-10-09: *"go ahead with the cat-harness chrome subgraph"*; proposal `docs/proposals/semantic-subgraphs-2026-10-09.md`, slice 1. The harness pages' own assets (`work-plan.*`, `process-index.js`, `slice-sqlite*`, `kg-render.js`, `vendor/sqlite-wasm`) stay in `docs/` (ruling D2).

Part of [C@T Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `site-chrome`, holding `docs`.
